FINAL PRACTICE ROOMS: Choose one thirty-minute session on Saturday. Room Cedar starts at 9:00 and 10:00. Room Maple starts at 9:30 and 10:30. Both rooms use the same practice passage and questions, but option order may differ between printed versions.

Arrive at least five minutes before your chosen start. Doors close when the session begins so the room can remain quiet. You may reserve one place only. If you change sessions, release the old place before confirming another.

After the timed session, an optional fifteen-minute discussion takes place in the same room. Check your paper's version before using the answer key. A printed explanation sheet is available afterward for students who cannot stay. The discussion and the sheet cover the same reasoning, so leaving after the session does not prevent you from reviewing the evidence later.
